actions.purpose: Explain a takeoff, quote, margin effect, or blocker to an authenticated owner or staff member
Hand a job, quote, or snapshot to measurement_design, purchasing_inventory, or another specialist with the expected next action
Record an abstention or pricing exception with its reason code and escalate it to a named person
Add reviewer context to a quote, takeoff, or change order that no proposal carries; a note is proposed context, never a fact
Draft a material takeoff from an accepted measurement version, committed design basis, and the price book's takeoff and waste rules
Draft a quote revision with options, sourced lines, cost build-up, margin, GST, and flags
Propose committing a complete draft revision; sales reviews, the owner below the margin floor or above the ceiling
Propose a discount revision requested by an authenticated person, with margin before and after; the owner decides below the floor
Flag open quotes whose consumed costs changed, with old and new prices and the exact margin effect
Propose a price-book or labour-rule review backed by job-cost history or cost facts; always asks the owner
Draft change-order pricing that references the accepted revision and reuses its price basis
Propose committing a change-order revision for review before the customer decides
Draft a contractor estimate for the customer's insurer from a committed quote revision, with no adjusting
Propose sending an approved supplement to the insurer with the customer's recorded authorization
